name.km: ខខ្មៅក្ដាម

description: A dark, glossy braise lacquered with dark soy and palm-sugar caramel.
descriptionKm: ខខ្មៅ — លាបជាមួយស៊ីអ៊ីវខ្មៅ និងស្ករត្នោត។
equipmentKm: ឆ្នាំងធ្ងន់

ingredients.notesKm: សម្អាត ហើយកាត់ជា ៤

ingredients.itemKm: ទឹកសុីអ៊ីវខ្មៅ
ផ្កាសុរ៉ាឌី

ingredients.notesKm: សម្រាប់បរិភោគ

instructions.text: Melt the palm sugar in a heavy pot until it caramelises to a deep amber.
instructions.tip: Take the caramel just to amber — too dark and it turns bitter.

instructions.text: Add the smashed garlic and the crab (cleaned and quartered); turn to coat in the caramel.
Add fish sauce and the braising liquid, plus the other aromatics.
Cover and braise gently until until the shells turn bright orange and the sauce is syrupy, about 32 minutes.
Uncover and reduce until glossy and clinging.
Serve hot with steamed jasmine rice.
instructions.textKm: បរិភោគជាមួយបាយក្ដៅ។
